provenance.type: read-only inventory of existing local artifacts; no new evaluation

base_vs_test_patch_presence.reason: The files this inventory consumes store parsed PASS_TO_PASS outcomes and coverage, not base checkout trees or test_patch diffs; dataset presence outside those consumed files is not established.
base_vs_test_patch_presence.minimal_cpu_check: For diagnosis, replay the selected 17 flagged cases against exact pinned dataset rows and base snapshots, and inspect whether each test existed at base or was introduced/changed by test_patch. Treat this selected-case replay as diagnostic only. A deployable test-selection rule must never consume PASS_TO_PASS IDs or gold test_patch and must be evaluated on all frozen issues, with untouched-base and resolved-patch controls.

interpretation.17_of_52: label-assisted opportunity/upper bound, not demonstrated deployable detection: the flag uses PASS_TO_PASS membership from the benchmark label and parser statuses from existing grading logs.
interpretation.zero_flagged_passing: parser/grader consistency check only; it is not an independent false-positive estimate because PASS_TO_PASS is benchmark-label machinery.
engineering_bottlenecks: resolve exact test identities and prove each existed at the base revision rather than being introduced by test_patch
missing/unparsed results remain unresolved and are never counted as defect detections; operational deferral is reported separately
measure false positives and test runtime on resolved patches plus untouched-base controls
evaluate caught failing 100s on held-out instances before claiming a 20-30% reduction in false approvals
